algorithm: Keep explicit SUPERSEDES priority and one-edge coverage for every new-Source endpoint.
Allocate second through fourth edges in round-robin passes over covered new endpoints instead of globally filling one topic first.
For each additional edge, rank by Relation-type priority, detector confidence, lexical novelty against already selected opposite-endpoint statements, endpoint affinity, then stable Relation id.
Lexical novelty equals one minus the maximum domain-neutral token overlap with already selected siblings for that new endpoint.
After round-robin facet allocation, fill any remaining source budget with the same marginal-diversity ordering.
forbiddenInputs: Stage B answer or gold label
the three deferred counterfactual-canonical Relation ids

interpretationLimits: Counterfactual canonical decisions are model-audited diagnostics, not a human gold standard.
MMR only schedules candidates for audit and cannot publish or semantically approve an edge.
The repair must improve generic sibling diversity; selecting three known ids through explicit exceptions is prohibited.
A four-source canary validates production wiring on the known pressure position but does not establish unseen-domain recall.
